notes: Searches: all 6 WebSearch calls used (MO, KS, IA, LA, AR, NE). Fetches: 34 used. Treasure Hunter (treasurehunter.show) and CardShopFinder (thecardshopfinder.com) are on the never-fetch list, so every show from those sites is a lead only, and none of their snippets was recorded as a fact. Organizer domains I guessed mostly did not resolve (omahacardshow.com, gascardshow.com, gascardshows.com, pokekonfest.com, southbridgemall.com, fortsmithconvention.com, stoneycreekhotel.com, rockwellbrewing.com). The only organizer-owned page that yielded verified future dates was the Shreveport Card Show SimpleTix storefront (4 editions in 2027). Venue names and addresses are recorded only where the organizer or venue page states them; Aug, Oct and Big Show editions carry city only because the storefront gives no venue. Known shows: TCG-Kon Rogers (Arkansas) shows Sat Dec 26 2026 10 am to 5 pm in one listing snippet, not verified on an organizer page, so nothing new recorded. TCG-Kon St. Louis and the two excluded St. Louis shows were not researched. Out of region and not recorded: Gulf Coast Card Show, Daphne, Alabama, Jun 27 2026 (past). Past shows without size data were not recorded (Shreveport Aug 1 and 2 2026, Arkansas Card Show Apr 2026, Fayetteville PokeKon Fest Oct 18 2026, Fort Smith Vintage Sports Oct 8 to 11 2026, Lincoln Fall Card Show Aug 29 to 30 2026, Omaha Husker Bound Sep 12 2026).
